2026-11-05GACSpecial Economic Measures ActRegulations Amending the Special Economic Measures (Iran) Regulations Regulations Amending the Special Economic Measures (Iran) Regulations in order to add eleven (11) entities to Schedule 1 of the Regulations, prohibiting them from transacting business with individuals and businesses in Canada, and freezing their assets unless otherwise authorized by the Minister of the Foreign Affairs.Registration: SOR/2026-0234 Publication Date: 2026-11-18
subject: Regulations Amending the Special Economic Measures (Iran) Regulations
precis: Regulations Amending the Special Economic Measures (Iran) Regulations in order to add eleven (11) entities to Schedule 1 of the Regulations, prohibiting them from transacting business with individuals and businesses in Canada, and freezing their assets unless otherwise authorized by the Minister of the Foreign Affairs.
